description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. W. S. Sathyananda as Secretary to the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing with effect from 21.11.2022
categorisation: The gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. W. S. Sathyananda) to a government position (Secretary to the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing). It names the person and their basic title but does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or subject areas they will be managing. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
